dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,9)><$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,644)><$facial(2,7)>HI-YAH!
<$voicel(2,3)><$comeff(2,7)><$motion(2,669)><$facial(2,14)>Urgggh, nope! That was sooo AWFUL!
<$motion(2,670)><$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$cdef(27)>Drilbur</color>! Not like you to pout, buddy! What’s wrong?

<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$cdef(27)>Hitmontop! OK, get this—when I dig through the dirt, I
<$voicel(2,8)><$motion(2,815)>usually do it like THIS, yeah?
<$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,53)>But I figured if I added a little spin move to it, I could
MEGA ULTRA DIG! <$voicel(2,2)><$emotion(2,47)><$kfacial(2)>But, uh, it’s not exactly going well...
<$voicel(2,4)><$comeff(2,17)><$motion(2,666)>Dang... Maybe I’m just not cut out for this.

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>What?! Uh-uh, no WAY that’s true! Your rotation on that
last one was GREAT!
<$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,805)>Wait, really?!
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,38)>Totally! You gotta believe in yourself!

<$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,8)>Yeah...YEAH! You’re so right! My spin wasn’t THAT bad!
<$voicel(2,8)><$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,644)><$facial(2,7)>All right, ONE MORE TRY!

<$facial(2,1)><$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,803)>WHOA! That one was fantastic! Amazing! <$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,815)>You and me are
like, SPIN TWINS!

<$emotion(2,5)>...Wowww.
<$voicel(2,3)><$comeff(2,18)><$motion(2,802)><$facial(2,9)>Your spin was basically a million times better than I could
ever do. Guess I’m really NOT built for the spinning life...
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,4)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,663)>Ack! Nooo! <$cdef(27)>Drilbur</color>! Don’t give in to despair! You got this!<$facial(1,1)>
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)><$cdef(27)>Illumise</color>! C’mon, let’s go for a walk together!

<$voicel(2,3)><$emotion(2,14)>Oh dear, <$cdef(27)>Volbeat, that’s no way to extend an invitation to
a lady!
<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,33)>Huh? Did I do somethin’ wrong?

<$voicel(2,6)><$motionoff(2,805)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,17)>Your choice of words is too coarse. You must speak in a
more courteous, refined manner.
<$voicel(2,7)><$motionoff(2,804)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,21)>And your demeanor is lacking—you need to be more...
fabulous! And elegant!

<$voicel(1,1)><$emotion(1,58)>I gotta be <$cdef(27)>Zweilous and <$cdef(27)>Elekid?! Wh-what does that
even MEAN?

<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,50)>That’s not what I said, you silly bean.
<$voicel(2,5)><$motionoff(2,805)><$facial(2,1)><$comeff(2,21)>In any case, it appears that you’re not quite ready to be
issuing invitations!

<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,20)>Aww... I only wanted to hang out together some.
<$voicel(1,7)><$motionoff(1,806)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)>It’s just that my happiest moments are whenever I’m with
YOU, <$cdef(27)>Illumise!

<$voicel(2,10)><$emotion(2,6)>Oh, you absolute darling. That was very sweet.
<$voicel(2,7)><$motionoff(2,807)><$comeff(2,1)>Well, if it means that much to you, I suppose we could go
for a short stroll. How does that sound?

<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,7)>FOR REAL?! Hahaha! HECK YEAH! I’m psyched! ♪
I seriously love you, <$cdef(27)>Illumise!

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)><$facial(1,4)>Your Majesty! We gathered up lots and lots of nectar
for you!
<$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,9)>See? Here’s some REALLY sweet nectar I found! <$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,49)>It’s all
sticky and yummy!

<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,15)>Hey! Stop trying to hog the spotlight!
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,805)>I was the one who found the flowers that smelled the
strongest! <$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,803)>So I bet MY nectar’s way tastier!

<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,806)>No, no, I think the queen’s gonna like mine
the best!
<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,1)><$motion(1,801)>It’s got a nice refreshing aftertaste so you can eat as
much of it as you want!

<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,49)>Come now, let’s not argue.
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,39)>I love equally all the nectar you three bring me. In fact,
<$voicel(2,8)><$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,803)>I will happily enjoy all of it!

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)>Really?! So, um, does that mean we can bring you
even MORE?
<$voicel(2,8)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,803)>Well, yes, I suppose...

<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)>Oooh, yaaay! We found lots more that we couldn’t carry,
<$voicel(1,6)>so we’ll bring AAALL that back too!

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,805)>Yeah, the liquidy stuff was that way, and the stuff that
smelled like berries was over that way!
<$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,8)><$motion(1,803)>We’re gonna bring you SO much nectar, Your Majesty!

<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,805)>Oh my... You truly have much more than this? I’m not
certain I can finish all that on my own...
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,49)>I know—let’s eat the nectar together! Yes, that’s what we
should do!
<$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,802)><$comeff(2,17)>Phew... I played a ton! Maybe I should take a little break.

<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,806)>How about a little stroll across the skyyy, then? Just hop
on, and I’ll take it from theeere.

<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,27)><$facial(2,4)>Really?! That sounds so fun!
<$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)>But, umm... I’m always on fire. I don’t want to burn
you, <$cdef(27)>Drifblim...
<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,49)>Nahhh. I actually really like the heat...
<$voicel(2,6)><$comeff(2,6)>Huh? Why?

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,1)>Whenever I give a hot Pokémon a riiide, I always feel like I
can go wayyyyyy higher than usual...
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,815)>I go so high that all the Pokémon on the grooouuund look
like little specks.

<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,5)>Uhhh... You can go THAT high up?
<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,4)>Hey, umm... How long does a stroll usually take? Could I,
like, get off in the middle, if I had to?
<$voicel(2,8)><$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,803)>Um, not that I’m scared!

<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,805)>I guess it depends on the wind... I once floated around
aaalllll daaay.
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,6)>Hehehe... I sure would like to try going hiiigher and
floating off even faaarther than I did then.

<$voicel(2,9)><$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,807)>N-no way! Absolutely not! No rides for me, thank you
very much!

<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,803)>Your claws are so big and cool, <$cdef(27)>Drilbur. I’m jealous...
My tusks are still pretty small.

<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>Hehehe—they’re amazing, right?! I can dig a hole straight
through to wherever I need to go!

<$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,666)>Whoa, that sounds so cool... <$comeff(2,6)>Can you dig a cave that I can
fit in?
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>I like caves <$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,39)>’cause it’s like having my own cozy secret base!

<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>’Course I can! I can do whatever you want, really. I could
make a SUPER long tunnel, or <$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,815)><$comeff(1,9)>even cover this whole
area with holes if you wanted!

<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,4)>Awesome! Yeah, let’s make some caves together!
And tunnels! HUGE ones!!!

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>YEAH! Let’s do it!
Wait, hold on... Isn’t <$cdef(27)>
<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,14)>fixing
up
the
land
for
everyone
around here?<$lookat(1,0,0)><$lookat(1,1,0)>
<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>Uhh... Should we really be digging a big ol’ cave?

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,1)>YEAH! C’mon, <$cdef(27)>, you gotta dig
with
us!
<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,9)>We
could
make
the
greatest
<$voicel(1,6)>cave
of
all time!
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Oh, <$cdef(27)><pname;0></color>! Perfect timing...

<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)>I always get all dried out whenever I chat with <$cdef(27)>Lampent...
<$voicel(2,4)><$emotion(2,29)>Could I ask you to splash me with <$cdef(27)><$sklfull(3)>?

<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,8)>Thank you!<$lookat(2,0,1)><$lookat(2,1,1)><$lookat(1,0,2)><$lookat(1,1,2)> <waitactor(1)><waitactor(2)><wait(0.5)><$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,14)><$motion(1,661)>Now, where were we...

<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,806)>You were talking about how you kept that lost kid safe,
right, <$cdef(27)>Lampent? <$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,21)><$motion(2,805)>Gosh, you’re so amazing...

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,801)>Nah, I just managed to help them out ’cause I know my
way around caves...
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>Wait...are you drying up again, <$cdef(27)>Goomy?
<$lookat(1,0,0)><$lookat(1,1,0)><$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)><$cdef(27)>,
could
you
hit
them
with
<$cdef(27)><$sklfull(3)><$cdef(27)>
again, please?

<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,29)>Uhhh...but how do you stop yourself from getting lost in a
cave in the first place?

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>When I turn a corner, I usually leave some kind of mark.
It helps me keep track of where I came from...

<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,8)>That’s a great idea! I gotta try it out next time.<$lookat(2,0,0)><$lookat(2,1,0)>
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,663)><$facial(2,9)>Um, hey... Sorry to keep asking, <$voicel(2,3)><$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,666)>but couldja spray me with
<$cdef(27)><$sklfull(3)> again, <$cdef(27)>?

<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,663)>Oh, looks like <$cdef(27)> is all tired out...
Thanks
for
all
the
watering.
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Maybe that’s enough talking for today... I had so much fun!

<$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,50)>Yeah! We got to talk a LOT today! <$lookat(2,1,0)>And it’s all thanks to
you, <$cdef(27)>!

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,48)>Whoa, your tusks are HUGE! Are mine gonna look like
that someday?

<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Well, now! If ya want tusks like mine, the most important
thing ya need...is courage!
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,666)><$comeff(1,6)>Huh? Whaddya mean?

<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,805)>I’ll give ya an example. Let’s say ya pick up a berry, and
it’s hard as a rock. What do ya do?

<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,27)>I’d split it open and eat it!
<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,31)>Oh, but I could hurt my tusks if I don’t split it right.
I don’t want that...

<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,29)>All right. What about when a strong Pokémon wants to
tussle with ya? Do ya fight back with yer tusks?

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,807)>What?! No way! I’d be too scared. And I don’t wanna
damage my trusty tusks! I’d run away.

<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,5)><$motionoff(2,804)>Well, that ain’t no good! No good at all! How do ya expect
to get stronger doin’ like that?!
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>Now listen up, <$cdef(27)>Axew. Even if ya break a tusk, it’ll jus’ grow
back! And each time it does, it’ll get stronger!
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,38)>Get rid o’ that fear! Chow down on lots of hard food!
Knock tusks with the toughest of opponents!

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Oh... I think—I think I get it now, <$cdef(27)>Haxorus!
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,5)><$motionoff(1,804)>I gotta be brave and step it up. So...I challenge you to
a battle! Bring it!
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,10)><$motionoff(2,804)>Heck yeah! That’s the spirit! Bring it on, <$cdef(27)>Axew</color>!

<$voicel(1,1)><$emotion(1,31)><$kfacial(1)>I can’t...take it...anymore...
Bleh... Blyeeeeeehhh...
<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,27)>Oh my! What’s the matter?!

<$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)>Just...just getting a bit...dried out... Just let me get to...
get to some shade and...I’ll be fi—
<$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,853)>FWOOOOOOSH!!!<wait(2.0)>
<$voicel(1,10)><$motion(1,807)><$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,13)>Goomf?!

<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,49)>How was that for ya?! My Hydro Pump works wonders,
don’t it?

<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Ooof... You don’t hold back at all, do you, <$cdef(27)>Blastoise?
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,661)><$facial(1,4)>But that did the trick! I’m all nice and moisturized!

<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,1)>I bet you are! But I reckon you might need a li’l more
waterin’! Get ready to get soaked! Hoo-ah!
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>Gyooom! ♪ Thank you so much!

<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,27)>Here I go!
<$motionoff(1,804)><$se2d(1045)><$textsize(2)>SCREEEEEEEECH!!!
<$comeff(0,4)><$motion(0,41)><$facial(0,20)><$voicel(2,10)><$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,802)><$facial(2,9)>Eeeeeek! It’s echoing in my head!
<$facial(0,1)><$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,1)>Hehe! Not bad, huh?

<$voicel(2,3)><$comeff(2,7)><$motion(2,807)><$facial(1,9)>Wuhhh... I feel it echoing round ’n’ round ’n’ round... Oh,
<$cdef(27)>!<$lookat(2,0,0)><$lookat(2,1,0)><$lookat(1,0,0)><$lookat(1,1,0)> <$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,6)>Did they get you too?
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>No way! <$cdef(27)>Supersonic</color> didn’t work on you?
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,50)><$pkcry;0(1,2)>! ♪ My <$cdef(27)>Supersonic</color> works like a charm!
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Hey, you know what? I can use <$cdef(27)>Supersonic </color>too!
<$lookat(2,1,1)><$lookat(1,1,2)><$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Oh yeah? You think it’s that easy? I’d like to see you try!

<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,8)>Hee hee, just you wait! Now listen close! *inhale*... ... ...
<$voicel(2,10)><$motion(2,817)><$comeff(2,5)><$textsize(2)>AAAAAAAAAAAA!!!
<$comeff(0,11)><$motion(0,182)><$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,11)><$motion(1,841)>HUH?! But that was...<wait(0.6)>just a yell.
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)>Hey. You. Quit copying me, got it?
<$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,4)><$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,663)>Whaaat? But I’m not...

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,807)>Save it, pal! I see those huge wings you’ve got. They look
just like mine!
<$voicel(2,3)><$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,666)>But looots of Pokémon have wings...

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,27)>And what about those cute little eyes, huh? Don’t try and
deny you’re copying mine!

<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,666)>Did you say cuuute? <$voicel(2,4)><$emotion(2,29)>Do you think your eyes are
cuuute, <$cdef(27)>Golbat?

<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,49)>To top it all off, you’ve got the GALL to try and steal my
best, most charming feature... My MASSIVE MOUTH!

<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,7)><$motion(2,666)><$facial(2,9)>Mine iiisn’t a mouth, it’s a beak. Your mouth is pretty big,
though... <$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,4)><$emotion(2,29)>You don’t get tired having it open all the time?

<$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,27)>Hey! Don’t try and change the subject!<$lookat(2,0,0)><$lookat(2,1,0)><$lookat(1,0,0)><$lookat(1,1,0)>
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>You see it, right, <$cdef(27)>? They’re
totally
copying me!

<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>Whaaat? If I were trying to copy you, I would do a waaay
better job at it. <$lookat(2,0,1)><$lookat(2,1,1)><$lookat(1,0,2)><$lookat(1,1,2)><$voicel(2,7)>See? Like this<$motionoff(2,804)>...

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,10)>HEY! What did I JUST say about copying me?! That pose is
off-limits from now on, got it?
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,802)><$facial(2,9)>Awwwwww...

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,27)>What?! You can’t be serious!
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,49)>Here I thought if anyone could spot a copycat, it’d be a
<$cdef(27)><$voicel(1,8)><$spwfull(36)>ation pro like you...

<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)>A <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(36)>ation pro?
<$voicel(2,3)>Hmmm... Are <$cdef(27)>’s
<$cdef(27)><$spwfull(36)>ations
really
<$comeff(0,11)><$facial(0,9)>that gooood?
<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,14)>Hmmmmmm...
<$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,4)><$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,807)>C-can I help you?
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Whatcha got under that cloth, huh?
<$voicel(2,6)><$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,666)>...Wh-why do you want to know?

<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,5)>I heard no one’s ever seen what’s under there, so I figure
you gotta be hiding some awesome treasure or something!

<$voicel(2,8)><$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,806)>What? I’m not hiding any treasure...
<$voicel(2,3)><$emotion(2,14)>I’m wearing this cloth so I don’t scare everyone...

<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>Really? Huh.
<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)>...OK, now I gotta see! Can I take a peek?
<$voicel(2,9)><$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,807)>W-weren’t you listening?! That’s really not a good idea...
<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,805)><$facial(1,4)>Don’t worry about it. I’m not scared of nothin’!
<$voicel(1,10)><$textsize(2)>M-M-MEAAAAAAUGH!</textsize>

<$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,5)>Ahhh! They saw me...and now <$cdef(27)>Meowth has collapsed on
the ground!<$lookat(2,0,0)><$lookat(2,1,0)>
<$voicel(2,6)><$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,666)>What should we do, <$cdef(27)>?

<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,807)>The horror... The horror!
<$voicel(1,1)><$comeff(1,18)><$motion(1,666)><$facial(1,9)><$kfacial(1)>How come I feel like I just lost one of my nine lives?
<$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>I did warn you... Don’t ever look again, OK?
